	is_shown = { ucm_single_player_trigger = yes }
	is_valid = { ucm_menu_target_valid_trigger = yes exists = var:ucm_target.culture var:ucm_target.culture = { NOT = { has_cultural_pillar = heritage_volga_finnic } } }
	effect = { var:ucm_target.culture = { set_culture_pillar = heritage_volga_finnic } }
}

	is_shown = { ucm_single_player_trigger = yes }
	is_valid = { ucm_menu_target_valid_trigger = yes }
	effect = { var:ucm_target.capital_province = { if = { limit = { NOT = { has_building_or_higher = orchards_01 } } add_building = orchards_01 } else_if = { limit = { NOT = { has_building_or_higher = orchards_02 } } add_building = orchards_02 } else_if = { limit = { NOT = { has_building_or_higher = orchards_03 } } add_building = orchards_03 } else_if = { limit = { NOT = { has_building_or_higher = orchards_04 } } add_building = orchards_04 } else_if = { limit = { NOT = { has_building_or_higher = orchards_05 } } add_building = orchards_05 } else_if = { limit = { NOT = { has_building_or_higher = orchards_06 } } add_building = orchards_06 } else_if = { limit = { NOT = { has_building_or_higher = orchards_07 } } add_building = orchards_07 } else_if = { limit = { NOT = { has_building_or_higher = orchards_08 } } add_building = orchards_08 } } }

ucm_toggle_personal_tenet = {
	scope = character
	saved_scopes = { pick_tenet }
	is_shown = { ucm_single_player_trigger = yes }
	is_valid = { ucm_menu_target_valid_trigger = yes var:ucm_target = { is_playable_character = yes } }
	effect = { var:ucm_target = { if = { limit = { scope:pick_tenet = flag:tenet_acts_of_apostles } if = { limit = { any_personal_tenet = { this = tenet:tenet_acts_of_apostles } } remove_personal_tenet = tenet:tenet_acts_of_apostles } else = { force_set_personal_tenet = tenet:tenet_acts_of_apostles } } else_if = { limit = { scope:pick_tenet = flag:tenet_adaptive } if = { limit = { any_personal_tenet = { this = tenet:tenet_adaptive } } remove_personal_tenet = tenet:tenet_adaptive } else = { force_set_personal_tenet = tenet:tenet_adaptive } } else_if = { limit = { scope:pick_tenet = flag:tenet_adoptionism } if = { limit = { any_personal_tenet = { this = tenet:tenet_adoptionism } } remove_personal_tenet = tenet:tenet_adoptionism } else = { force_set_personal_tenet = tenet:tenet_adoptionism } } else_if = { limit = { scope:pick_tenet = flag:tenet_adorcism } if = { limit = { any_personal_tenet = { this = tenet:tenet_adorcism } } remove_personal_tenet = tenet:tenet_adorcism } else = { force_set_personal_tenet = tenet:tenet_adorcism } } else_if = { limit = { scope:pick_tenet = flag:tenet_alexandrian_catechism } if = { limit = { any_personal_tenet = { this = tenet:tenet_alexandrian_catechism } } remove_personal_tenet = tenet:tenet_alexandrian_catechism } else = { force_set_personal_tenet = tenet:tenet_alexandrian_catechism } } else_if = { limit = { scope:pick_tenet = flag:tenet_anachoresis } if = { limit = { any_personal_tenet = { this = tenet:tenet_anachoresis } } remove_personal_tenet = tenet:tenet_anachoresis } else = { force_set_personal_tenet = tenet:tenet_anachoresis } } else_if = { limit = { scope:pick_tenet = flag:tenet_ancestor_worship } if = { limit = { any_personal_tenet = { this =
